name: bijaku0
about: bijaku (微弱, weak) 0: curve k = 0 of the eleven of Sec. 26 (October (2026)#Y-0NbRU, Fig. 0NNbp), the case of uijin, gamma_sigma = 293/780364 g = 0.003755 gamma_a (gamma_a = 0.1 g; g2(P->0) = 0.6667), on the log series P_i = 0.001 x 500^(i/24) g, i = 0..24 (0.001-0.5 g, 25 pumps, 8.9 a decade, each to 3 significant digits) (Fabrice, 15 Nov 2026: 'let's prepare a Psigma log series at small pumpings, until 0.5', 'with pilot to check convergence issues, not computing very nearby 0.3-0.4% off pumps and having 0.502 counting as 0.5; this should run together with the ongoing hokan, same priority, running in //'); the pumps of the case done already within 0.5 % stand for 4 of its points (0.177 by uijin's 0.178 g, 0.298 by uijin's 0.298 g, 0.386 by uijin's 0.386 g, 0.5 by uijin's 0.5 g); first a pilot of 1 pump (0.001 g), then the series (added by --zoen once the pilot has spoken, code/bijaku_pilot.py); code/bijaku_specs.py 1.0

parts.about: the pilot: the bottom of the series, 0.001 g, at orders 150 with weights, 200, 250, 300 and 400 at 80 digits and 300 at 160 digits: whether 150/200 (B), 250/300 (D) agree with 300/400 (E) there, and whether 80 digits hold; uijin has no pump of all orders below 0.6 g, so above 0.022 g the series takes uijin's own orders there, B (code/bijaku_pilot.py --sakusen bijaku0)

the series of bijaku0: the log series P_i = 0.001 x 500^(i/24) g, i = 0..24 (0.001-0.5 g, 25 pumps, 8.9 a decade, each to 3 significant digits), but the pilot's 0.001 g and the 4 points that pumps of the case done already stand for (0.177 by uijin's 0.178 g, 0.298 by uijin's 0.298 g, 0.386 by uijin's 0.386 g, 0.5 by uijin's 0.5 g): 20 pumps, numbered by their index i in the series, from the bottom up, at 80 digits; the orders as the pilot set them (code/bijaku_pilot.py --sakusen bijaku0): B (150w, 200) below 0.022 g, B (150w, 200) on 0.022-0.5 g; 20 pumps, 14.3 kh

the refinement of the series of bijaku0 (uijin), van der Corput level 0: of the grid 0.001 x 500^(j/384) g (j = 176..316, 0.017259-0.16635 g) and n/320 g (n = 54..160, 0.16875-0.5 g, 64 per period of 0.2 g), the pumps whose index is a multiple of 16 (the old points 0.0173-0.137 g at their exact values, and the multiples of 0.05 g): 15 pumps, in increasing pump, at 80 digits, orders 150w and 200 (B, as the pilot set for 0.001-0.5 g); 1 done already at exactly their pump not computed again (0.5 g); added by code/tengo_dispatch.py 1.6

the refinement of the series of bijaku0 (uijin), van der Corput level 1: of the grid 0.001 x 500^(j/384) g (j = 176..316, 0.017259-0.16635 g) and n/320 g (n = 54..160, 0.16875-0.5 g, 64 per period of 0.2 g), the pumps whose index is an odd multiple of 8: 16 pumps, in increasing pump, at 80 digits, orders 150w and 200 (B, as the pilot set for 0.001-0.5 g); added by code/tengo_dispatch.py 1.6 once level 0 is complete in all ten cases
